name: angkorcraft
description: AngkorCraft — marketplace for authentic Cambodian artisans (frontend + backend).

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
